replies.author: Gigaslavx
replies.body:
I see people make much better demos and at the end of the day it's still reused assets for most part or something rushed with zero monetization value

I understand people sharing impressive demos

And especially this is ai assisted game dev sub why bother sharing something that can be literally made in like 3 hours I guess?

I understand a cool idea but what I see astra light can do in about 3-5 prompts

Not trying to be rude but game is goofy looking it's close to satire

replies.author: pianoboy777
replies.body: How much does your Astra cost to make something as simple looking as what I showed you ? Lol also that's made in the Godot Engine. I only use llms for code. The mountains, water, and rain are all procedural. The trees are a free asset because it doesn't have to look pretty until it's done lol you haven't designed much yourself yet have you ?

replies.author: Gigaslavx
replies.body:
Sounds good mate I'm not here to argue

You know how in perfume store you need to sniff coffee beans just because you get so used to something? All I am saying from a neutral non biased perspective there is close to 0 value. You ask for feedback and you get objective feedback without people being rude. Sorry if this is not something you were looking for

All the best ❤️
